newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Waterford Wedgwood takes strategic Rosenthal stake.
newsitem.headline: Waterford Wedgwood takes strategic Rosenthal stake.

text.p: Irish crystal and china firm Waterford Wedgwood Plc said Thursday it was taking a 9.1 percent stake in Rosenthal AG as part of a strategic alliance with the German porcelain firm.

It said it had options to acquire another 15 percent of Rosenthal over the next four years. The initial 9.1 percent stake would be acquired through the issue of 60,000 new Rosenthal shares at or close to the market price.

The company gave no indication of how much it expected to pay for the stake, but Irish analysts said that based on Rosenthal's current share price, Waterford Wedgwood would pay around 2.5 million punts ($4.2 million).

The alliance between two of the world's famous names in porcelain would improve joint penetration of the German and British markets and foster improved overseas sales for Rosenthal, Waterford Wedgwood said.

"Rosenthal is a lovely fit for Wedgwood," said Joe Burnell, an analyst at Davy Stockbrokers. "It's a fine brand but it doesn't have many sales outside Europe. Conversely, Wedgwood doesn't have many sales in mainland Europe. So the two will be able to complement each other on that score," he said.
